item.title: Fixing 'regeneratorRuntime is not defined' When Using Async/Await with Babel
item.description:
“Fixing ‘regeneratorRuntime is not defined’ When Using Async/Await with Babel”

This compilation task necessitates providing the required runtime support, which has evolved significantly with different Babel versions. How can one correctly configure Babel, Webpack, Mocha, or direct script inclusion to ensure regeneratorRuntime is available?

Strategies for Ensuring regeneratorRuntime Availability

The approach to resolving this issue varies based on the Babel version in use (Babel 6 vs. Babel 7+) and the build tools integrated into the project (Webpack, Mocha, etc.).
